department: College of Engineering and Computer Science

deadline.value: The university's preferred date for international Fall applicants is June 30; the program page gives no date of its own.

gre_general.value: Applicants must meet minimum GRE scores, but the GRE is waived for Wright State engineering graduates.
gre_general.quote: Minimum GRE (Graduate Record Examinations) requirements: Verbal ≥ 145 and Quantitative ≥ 156 and Analytical Writing ≥ 3.0

also.quote: or Combined Verbal + Quantitative ≥ 301 and Analytical Writing ≥ 3.0
GRE requirements are waived for applicants who received their engineering degree from WSU

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department requires a TOEFL of 79 for international applicants.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) ≥ 79

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS of 6.0 for international applicants.

supervisor.value: Applicants must provide a letter of support from the faculty member they want to work with.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are required to provide a letter of support signed by the WSU DQF with whom the student would like to do research

funding.value: The admission page does not say whether admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an engineering B.S. (ABET or equivalent, GPA 3.0) or an engineering M.S. (GPA 3.5).
entry_route.quote: B.S. degree in Engineering from an ABET-accredited program or equivalent, with a minimum 3.0 grade-point average

also.quote: or an M.S. degree from an engineering program, with a minimum 3.5 grade-point average

notes: Umbrella Ph.D. in Engineering with research focus areas: Biomedical Engineering, Industrial and Human Factors Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, and Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering. Saved under mech; bme and materials listed in also_fields. Industrial and Human Factors has no field id in fields.json. Department TOEFL and IELTS overrides apply.
